verdict.rationale: HubSpot publishes an extensive, well-documented REST API (CRM objects, contacts, custom objects, webhooks, account info) with CLI tooling, date-based versioning, a deprecation policy, and machine-readable OpenAPI specs per endpoint plus llms.txt-style markdown docs, giving AI-native users a documented way to drive the product programmatically. Probes show the root-level llms.txt/openapi.json shortcuts 404, meaning discovery isn't as frictionless as top-level files would suggest, though per-endpoint OpenAPI specs and .md docs are confirmed. missing for 10: a single consolidated machine-readable spec/llms.txt at the root, and independent (non-vendor) developer confirmation of API robustness in production use.
